subject: Fiscal Year 2024 Community Preservation Act Appropriations
overview: The committee reviewed and recommended approval for ten projects totaling over $1.1 million in Community Preservation Act (CPA) funding for affordable housing, historic preservation, and open space projects.

items.title: FY24 Community Preservation Fund Annual Appropriations
items.summary: Reported out favorably ten funding requests for projects including rental assistance, restoration of historic cemeteries, park resurfacing, and ADA improvements at the Brooks Estate. Discussion addressed the criteria for housing support, geographic equity in park maintenance, and the role of the newly established Affordable Housing Trust.
